title: Concept Regions Matter: Benchmarking CLIP with a New Cluster-Importance Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models (like CLIP) using the custom COVAR benchmark, which systematically places foreground objects into diverse, synthesized background contexts. The study uses a novel Cluster-based Concept Importance (CCI) interpretability method to measure whether the model's attention and predictions are driven by the foreground object or spuriously correlated background regions.

bias_targets.target: Structural and Geometric bias (Scale, Viewpoint, and Transformation sensitivity)
bias_targets.methodology: Applying controlled structural transformations to images—including scale shifts, viewpoint changes, horizontal/vertical flips, cropping, and translation—to measure accuracy degradation and identify the dominant visual factors influencing model failure modes.
